c74object.name: breakgen
c74object.digest: Generate tempo multipliers and breakpoint files for modmetro~
c74object.description:
Each bang advances an oscillator one step and outputs its value, shifted to center on 1.0, as a tempo multiplier. modmetro~ multiplies the length of each beat by one of these values: 1.0 leaves the beat unchanged, values above 1.0 lengthen it (slower) and values below 1.0 shorten it (faster).
The oscillator can be a sine, triangle, square, saw down or saw up wave, or a constant value, and its output can be randomized. Use writefile to save a run of values as a breakpoint text file that modmetro~ can read, or writebuf to write them into a buffer~.
The oscillator advances by freq / sr of a cycle per step, so one full cycle takes sr / freq steps. With the defaults (sr 10000, freq 100) a cycle lasts 100 beats.

inlet.digest: (bang) Output the next tempo multiplier, (messages) set parameters or write a file or buffer~
inlet.description: A bang outputs the next value. All other messages configure the oscillator and randomization or write values to a file or buffer~.

outlet.digest: (float) Tempo multiplier for the next beat's length
outlet.description: The current oscillator value plus 1.0, after randomization. The periodic waveforms range from 0.0 to 2.0, so at full depth a beat can shrink to nothing or double in length. writefile can scale this range down; the outlet always sends the full range.

method.name: bang
method.description: Advances the oscillator one step, applies the current random mode, and sends the result out the outlet.

method.name: wavetype
method.description: 0 = sine (default), 1 = triangle, 2 = square, 3 = saw down, 4 = saw up, 5 = constant. Type 5 outputs the constval value on every step instead of an oscillator. Values outside 0–5 are reported as an error and ignored. Changing the waveform keeps the oscillator's current phase. Same as set wavetype.

method.name: freq
method.description: Together with sr, sets how quickly the waveform cycles: one cycle takes sr / freq steps. Must be greater than 0; other values are ignored. The default is 100. Same as set freq.

method.name: sr
method.digest: Set the step rate and restart the oscillator
method.description: The number of steps per second of the oscillator, by analogy with an audio sample rate. One cycle takes sr / freq steps. Setting it also resets the oscillator's phase to the start of the cycle, which makes it the way to restart a waveform from the beginning. Must be greater than 0. The default is 10000. Same as set sr.

method.name: constval
method.digest: Set the value for the constant waveform
method.description: The value output on every step when wavetype is 5. Must be greater than 0; other values are ignored (set constval accepts any number). The default is 1.0.

method.name: set
method.description:
The word set followed by a parameter name and one value. Numeric parameters accept ints or floats.
set freq float: oscillator frequency, greater than 0 (see freq).
set sr float: step rate, greater than 0; also restarts the oscillator (see sr).
set wavetype int: waveform, 0–5 (see wavetype).
set constval float: value for the constant waveform. Unlike the constval message, any value is accepted.
set random int: random mode, 0–3:
0 = no random (default).
1 = replace: every output is a new random value between 0.0 and 2.0, ignoring the waveform.
2 = multi: each output moves toward a new random value between 0.0 and 2.0 by the intensity fraction.
3 = multi interp: like multi, but the random target glides smoothly to a new random value every interval steps.
set intensity float: how far modes 2 and 3 pull each output toward the random value. 0 = not at all, 1 = all the way; negative values push away from it. The default is 0.05.
set interval int: the number of steps between new random targets in mode 3. Must be at least 1. The default is 1.
set buffer symbol: names a buffer~ to reference and reports whether it exists. writebuf takes its own buffer name, so this currently has no other effect.
An unknown parameter, a missing value or a value of the wrong type is reported in the Max Console and leaves the setting unchanged.

method.name: writefile
method.digest: Write a breakpoint file for modmetro~
method.description:
Opens a Save dialog, then writes steps values to the chosen text file, one per line with no trailing newline. This is the format modmetro~ reads. Each value advances the oscillator exactly as a bang would.
The optional depth scales each value's distance from 1.0, written as (value − 1) × depth + 1. A depth of 0.2 keeps a sine between 0.8 and 1.2, i.e. beats up to 20% shorter or longer. It is only used when it is less than 1.0; otherwise the full range is written, which lets beats shrink to zero length at the bottom of a sine.

method.name: writebuf
method.description: Writes steps values into the named buffer~, one per sample frame, stopping at the end of the buffer. Each value advances the oscillator as a bang would, but 1.0 is subtracted so the values center on 0.0 (−1.0 to 1.0 for the periodic waveforms). In a multichannel buffer every channel gets the same value. This also makes the buffer the object's referenced buffer (see set buffer). An error is reported if the buffer doesn't exist.

entry.name: float
entry.description: A tempo multiplier, centered on 1.0, for each bang.
